title: Rethinking Knowledge Distillation for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33670v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge distillation has recently proven highly effective for improving autoregressive models, but its applicability to DLMs remains poorly understood. We present the first systematic study of KD for DLMs and uncover two non-intuitive failures of classical forward-KL (FKL) distillation: (i) student perplexity does not improve monotonically with more teacher-generated data, and (ii) on the same teacher-generated corpus, FKL distillation underperforms simply training the student with the original DLM denoising objective. To address them, we propose a unified, data-free distillation framework for masked DLMs. First, the framework runs an off-policy distillation phase that absorbs general knowledge from a static set of teacher-generated data. translated_title: 重新思考扩散语言模型的知识蒸馏
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏最近被证明对于改进自回归模型非常有效，但其在扩散语言模型（DLM）中的适用性仍知之甚少。我们首次对扩散语言模型的知识蒸馏进行了系统性研究，并揭示了经典前向KL散度（FKL）蒸馏的两个反直觉的失败现象：(i) 学生的困惑度并不会随着教师生成数据的增加而单调改善；(ii) 在相同的教师生成语料库上，FKL蒸馏的表现甚至不如直接使用原始DLM去噪目标来训练学生模型。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一个统一的、无数据的掩码扩散语言模型蒸馏框架。首先，该框架运行一个离策略蒸馏阶段，从静态的教师生成数据集中吸收通用知识。然后，该框架采用在策略蒸馏，其中包含三种技术：沿学生自身逆过程的轨迹损失、对（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文首次系统性研究了扩散语言模型的知识蒸馏，揭示了前向KL散度蒸馏的两个反直觉失败现象，并提出了一种结合离策略与在策略蒸馏的统一无数据蒸馏框架，有效提升掩码扩散语言模型的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic study of knowledge distillation for diffusion language models, reveals two counterintuitive failures of forward-KL distillation, and proposes a unified data-free distillation framework combining off-policy and on-policy distillation to effectively improve masked diffusion language models.
